CREATE TRIGGER inbox_project_insert AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
    DELETE FROM inbox_raw WHERE thread_id=NEW.thread_id AND message_id=NEW.id;
    INSERT INTO inbox_raw(source_row,thread_id,message_id,at,kind,expired,run_id,routine_id,source_key,status,summary,title,kind_segment,terminal,decision) SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('resolved','completed','failed','cancelled','stopped','missed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('pending','waiting','needs-input','needs-you') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM (SELECT m.rowid AS source_row, m.thread_id, m.id AS message_id, m.at, m.kind,
    COALESCE(json_extract(m.json,'$.card.expired'),0) AS expired,
    json_extract(m.json,'$.routineRun.runId') AS run_id, json_extract(m.json,'$.routineRun.routineId') AS routine_id,
    json_array(m.thread_id,m.kind,CASE m.kind
      WHEN 'options' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(m.json,'$.card.requestId'),json_extract(m.json,'$.card.routineRequest.requestId'),json_extract(m.json,'$.card.skillRequest.requestId'),m.id)

BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO shared_ready_teams(bot_id,team,thread_id,seq,waiting) SELECT NEW.to_bot_id, json_extract(NEW.execution_audience,'$.team'), NEW.target_thread_id, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(s.seq),0)+1 FROM shared_ready_teams s WHERE s.bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id), 0 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_requests r WHERE r.state='queued' AND r.refusal IS NOT 'retained_unresolved' AND r.to_bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id AND json_extract(r.execution_audience,'$.team')=json_extract(NEW.execution_audience,'$.team'));
  UPDATE shared_ready_teams SET seq=CASE WHEN waiting=1 THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(s.seq),0)+1 FROM shared_ready_teams s WHERE s.bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id) ELSE seq END, waiting=0, wait_on=NULL, gen=gen+1, thread_id=COALESCE(
  (SELECT h.target_thread_id FROM room_requests h WHERE h.state='queued' AND h.verb='wake' AND h.refusal IS NOT 'retained_unresolved' AND h.shared_work=1 AND h.to_bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id AND json_extract(h.execution_audience,'$.team')=json_extract(NEW.execution_audience,'$.team') ORDER BY h.created_at, h.id LIMIT 1),

  thread_id) WHERE bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id AND team=json_extract(NEW.execution_audience,'$.team');
  -- a running request of the bot ended: one of the bot's slots is free, so the oldest teams waiting on the bot are ready again (directly, not by a page or the sweep)
  UPDATE shared_ready_teams SET seq=CASE WHEN waiting=1 THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(s.seq),0)+1 FROM shared_ready_teams s WHERE s.bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id) ELSE seq END, waiting=0, wait_on=NULL, gen=gen+1 WHERE bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id AND OLD.state IN ('running','waiting_owner','waiting_bot') AND team IN (SELECT w.team FROM shared_ready_teams w WHERE w.bot_id=NEW.to_bot_id AND w.waiting=1 AND w.wait_on='bot' ORDER BY w.seq, w.team LIMIT 8);
